The '''Froffl system''' was located in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Froffli]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SoP" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Froffl [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square P-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
